teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.subtitle: Active and disabled teachers at the school.
teachers.combinedSubtitle: Give your colleagues a good start. Invite them to your school and see who has joined.
teachers.listText: Active teachers use a teacher seat. Disabled teachers can be activated again if the license has room.
teachers.inviteInlineText: We send an email invitation. The teacher can use an existing account or create a new one.
teachers.pendingInvitesText: These invitations can still be printed with QR code or used as links.
teachers.noPendingInvites: No invitations are waiting for a reply. New invitations will appear here.
teachers.empty: No teachers found. Invite teachers from the invitations page, or reset the filters.
teachers.name: Name
teachers.memberNotFound: The teacher is not a school member.
teachers.notSchoolTeacher: This member is not a school teacher.
teachers.invalidSeatLimit: The school license does not have a valid teacher limit.

spaces.title: Teacher spaces
spaces.subtitle: See teacher spaces at the school and open them for substitute work, assessment, or practical follow-up.
spaces.searchPlaceholder: Search space, teacher, email, or code...

invites.title: Invitations
invites.subtitle: Overview of school invitations that have been created.
invites.createdNoEmail: Invitation created, but email was not sent automatically.
invites.fallbackText: The email wasn’t sent. Share the link with the teacher or print the invitation.
invites.controlText: You can also share the link directly or print a QR invitation.
invites.temporaryLink: Your invitation is ready to share
invites.temporaryLinkText: Copy this link if the teacher does not receive email.
invites.printInvitationText: Opens a printable page with link and QR code.
invites.empty: No invitations found. Create a new invitation above, or reset the filters.
invites.revokeConfirm: Remove the invitation for {label}? This frees the teacher seat.
invites.pendingInviteExists: There is already a pending invitation for this email address.

welcome.newIntro: We’re glad you’re here! Start by inviting your teachers. You can follow their invitations and help colleagues get started at their own pace.
welcome.returnIntro: Keep your teachers and their rooms in view. Invite new colleagues, manage access and find what you need for everyday school life.
welcome.stepsTitle: Get started, one step at a time
welcome.dailyTitle: What would you like to do today?
welcome.stepsIntro: You don’t have to set everything up at once. We’ll help you along the way.
welcome.inviteText: Enter a teacher’s email address. They receive an invitation and connect their account to the school when they accept.
welcome.followTitle: Follow up at your own pace
welcome.followText: See who has joined and who is still waiting. You can also share an invitation link or print a QR code.
welcome.roomsText: As teachers start using their rooms, you’ll find them here. It makes it easier to help out and follow up when needed.
welcome.capacityText: You have {count} teacher seats available. Pending invitations reserve a seat until the teacher joins.
welcome.statisticsText: Once you get started, you can follow activity and usage here. The numbers are ready whenever you need them.
welcome.statisticsIntro: Explore school activity and how teachers use the tools. Your overview grows as everyone gets started.
welcome.licenseIntro: Find teacher seats and license information here. Pending invitations are included in capacity.
welcome.noTeachers: Your first colleagues will appear here when they accept their invitations. Start with the email field above — we’ll take it from there.
welcome.noRooms: This is where your teachers’ rooms will appear. As teachers create and use rooms, you’ll find them here.

batch.title: Invite several colleagues at once
batch.intro: Add names and emails. Choose whether to send emails or just create invitations to print and hand out. Teachers can register afterwards.
batch.name: Name (optional)
batch.pasteHelp: One colleague per line: name and email, separated by a tab or semicolon. This replaces the rows above.
batch.capacity: {count} colleagues in the list · {available} available seats
batch.listIntro: Hand one invitation to each colleague. This list includes all active pending invitations with a link. Invitations expire 14 days after creation.
batch.registerHelp: Scan the QR code or open the link. Sign in or create an account using the email address above.
batch.manualHelp: Without QR: open {url} and enter the code.
batch.empty: No active invitations to print yet.
batch.signIn: Sign in as a school administrator to open this list.
batch.failed: Could not create or load invitations.
batch.created: {count} invitations are ready to hand out. Open the invitation list for printing and QR codes.
batch.createdWithFailures: {count} invitations were created. Email was not sent to {unsent} recipients; use the invitation list to share these.
batch.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address for each colleague.
batch.invalid_name: Names can be up to 120 characters.
batch.duplicate_email: The same email address appears more than once.
batch.seat_limit_reached: The list exceeds the available teacher seats. Remove rows or increase capacity.
batch.pending_invite_exists: A colleague already has an active invitation. Remove them from the list and try again.
batch.member_exists: A colleague already has active school access.
batch.school_not_active: The school license is not active.
batch.invalid_seat_limit: The license is missing a valid teacher seat limit.

accept.invite_not_found: Invitation not found. Check the code or link.
accept.invite_not_pending: This invitation has been used or removed.

accept.school_not_active: The school license is not active.
